rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the signing target sweeps a distribution/output folder
Recognized that multiple projects write to the same output folder
Connected the access-denied error to file ownership or read-only constraints (such as CAS hard links in CloudBuild)
Explained why the failure is non-deterministic (depends on project build order / timing)
Suggested separating project outputs or removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy configurations from library projects

scenarios.reasoning: The investigation was efficient and reached a plausible, evidence-backed root cause (parallel-build race over a shared Distrib folder). However, the delivered final output is a weak one-line restatement responding to a stray shell notification, with the substantive analysis truncated and no clear actionable remediation (separating outputs, removing redundant Distrib/Robocopy) confirmed. Also missed the read-only/hard-link angle. Solid diagnosis, mediocre deliverable.
